C-RU-NATURAL-ALIGNMENT.Summary: Realign the Russian charter and portal sources with the current English sources and rewrite them from word-for-word renderings into natural, formal Russian, applying the shared terminology and a reviewed translation map.

Goals.Goal: Every Russian charter and portal source states the same rules, rights, conditions, limits, periods, quantities and facts as its current English counterpart; sentence-level drift found by comparison is corrected.
Russian prose reads as native formal institutional Russian (normative, business, finance and IT register), not as a calque of English word order, nominal chains or capitalisation.

The Russian edition of Shared Business and Technology Terminology and the Russian translation map are applied consistently across every in-scope source; accepted forms replace stray Latin and rejected forms.
Russian defined terms are written in lowercase, as Russian usage requires, except proper names, document titles and fixed international names.
The translation map grows into a complete reference: section 5 entries are reviewed and moved into sections 3–4 or dropped, and new findings from the rewrite are added.

Constraints.Constraint: Authority: the owner requested alignment of the Russian corpus and portal with the recently updated English and a natural rewrite of the Russian text, and decided on 4 October 2026 that (a) Russian defined terms are written in lowercase, (b) translation map section 5 entries are reviewed and then approved or dropped before use, and (c) scope is the charter and the portal; Registry and Portfolio are excluded.
English sources are byte-identical to the start baseline. If comparison shows the English is the drifted side, the finding is reported to the owner, not fixed in English.

Preserve filenames, front matter fields, identifiers, numbered headings, clause numbers, table row and column order, empty cells, link targets, page: references, placeholders, JSON keys and Mermaid node and edge identities. Mermaid labels may be reworded.

Wording changes never change meaning: no decision right, obligation strength, condition, limit, period, status or quantity is added, removed or weakened. Normative force follows Russian legal drafting (present tense for duties of a named party, «не допускается» or «не вправе» for prohibitions) as the translation map sets.

Lowercasing defined terms is a style change of the Russian edition only. It is recorded in the Russian Vocabulary and Style rule, the Russian terminology reference and the translation map, and the build's Russian reference-name recognition is kept working for the new spelling.
Generated HTML is rebuilt from sources and never patched by hand. Unrelated portals, working-tree changes and installed skills remain unchanged.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Translate or restyle registry/ru or portfolio/ru; their capitalisation stays as is until a later change.
Change English sources, policy, decisions, operational states or approvals, or claim human review.
Deploy to the websvc server; promotion to the deployment repository is limited to a branch there.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: All 40 Russian charter files, all 117 Russian portal pages and the content index, the Russian fields of authored.json and messages/ru.json are compared sentence by sentence with their English sources and rewritten where needed; each has a recorded disposition.
No rejected («не: …») form of the approved translation map remains in a situation the map covers; Latin business case and other non-accepted Latin forms are gone from Russian prose.
Translation map section 5 is empty or contains only explicitly deferred entries with a reason; sections 3–4 hold the approved entries.
Structure checks show unchanged headings, clause numbers, table shapes, links and diagram topology against the English sources; source_sha256 values match the current English files.
Source, unit, scaffolding and generated-site checks pass; a repeat build is identical; changed Russian routes, search and cross-references are inspected in the rendered portal.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Per-file review inventory with drift findings and dispositions; rejected-form scan before and after; structure comparison; rendered-page inspection of changed Russian routes.
